meta.verticalDatum: CGVD28 / GSD95 source elevations; per-building measured ground subtracted for flat terrain
meta.sourceRecordDateMeaning: DATE_ field values copied from the GDB; not independently verified acquisition dates
meta.wallOrientationMethod: Height-aware vertical roof-ray occupancy at 0.08, 0.2 and 0.6 metre horizontal wall-normal probes; only provably inward faces flipped
meta.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – City of Calgary.
meta.binaryFormat: 16-byte header (CGMESH1\0, uint32 recordCount, float32 quantization), then per-record int16 xyz vertices followed by uint16/uint32 triangle indices; little endian
limitations: Building roof and wall shape only; no facade photography or invented interior detail.
Survey age varies by structure. Newer or poorly matched footprints retain explicit fallback geometry.
Local ground is flattened per building; measured absolute ground elevations remain available in metadata.
Custom landmark replacements must be excluded by the renderer before requesting these models.

partialCompound.sourceDateMeaning: City DATE_ record field; acquisition date not independently verified
partialCompound.sourceFootprintMethod: Exact planar union of all nondegenerate projected triangles in the published quantized City payload; coincident collinear boundary vertices removed without shape change.
partialCompound.sourceHeightMethod: Source roof planes and walls normalized by the original City record mean ground 1047.955 m; ground datum and raw elevation range retained. No COPC height/ground replacement accepted.

partitionProof.method: GEOS/Shapely 2.1.2 exact polygon intersection/difference/union on decoded source payload XY and unchanged bundled baseline; no buffer/inset or blanket replacement.

limitations: Only the exact City fragment is measured source geometry; the remaining 57.188% of the original compound is retained baseline footprint/height extrusion.
Baseline-only slivers and rear extensions are preserved because there is insufficient evidence to delete or assign them to individual neighbors.
The City shell extends outside the newer 2D outline by 15.361 m2; it is preserved, not clipped, and that alignment difference remains explicit.
DATE_ 2012-10-19 is a record field, not independently verified LiDAR acquisition or proof of every present-day feature.
The source is grounded using the original City record. Independent COPC local-ground acceptance previously failed, so no cloud-derived vertical correction is claimed.
The full original compound body/collider may be suppressed only after this exact shell and every disjoint remainder piece are ready.
No facade photograph is included in these geometry assets; a separate measured-wall provider may register a clearly documented partial photographic span.

existingOwnershipAudit.policy: Every current primary/recovered/OSM-part/COPC model was checked for this source STRUCT_ID or baseline ID, and the measured projection was intersected against all other bundled building footprints. No conflicting source owner or positive-area neighboring footprint overlap was found. Future geometry-source changes require this check again.
